_comment: Why each unshipped Vega provider stays out. Keyed by the id in docs/vega-triage.json. `family` groups providers behind the same gate so a future round does not re-probe them one by one; `checked` is the date the evidence was last confirmed.

1cinevood.reason: one.cinevood.business does not resolve; the mirrors printed on the old home page are dead too

1flex.reason: altcha proof-of-work plus a WASM solver

Joya9tv.reason: posts link to #download anchors and the page contains no stream host at all; its wp-json returns an empty array, so the file list is injected client-side

a111477.reason: the Vega manifest lists no domain for it

aniDream.reason: anidream.to answers again (414 KB of HTML, /anime/<id> and /watch?id=<id>&n=<n> pages of 54 KB) but the player is injected client-side: its /api/* prefix answers 406 'Only HTML requests are supported here' for every JSON Accept and the real routes are not derivable from the served HTML

animerulz.reason: animerulz.com now answers 401 and animerulz.tv does not resolve

animesaltravok.reason: the ravok.buzz player path is gone

animetsu.reason: the Vega manifest lists no domain for it

cinefreak.reason: cinefreak.net answers 204 KB, but a post leads to cinecloud.top/f/<token> whose download still needs a Google OAuth session

disneyMirror.reason: needs an app-session token from a mobile build; the web surface has no catalogue

dooflix.reason: no base URL left in the manifest

dramacool.reason: dramacool.com answers but serves a 5.5 KB placeholder; asianc.id still redirects to asianctv.do, which does not resolve

eonMovies.reason: /QuickSearch?name= answers JSON (id, title, year, type) but no post, watch or movie route serves a player; the web surface has no stream at all

everything.reason: the Vega manifest lists no domain for it

filmyfly.reason: filmyfiy.co.in and filmyfly.co do not resolve

flixhq.reason: no public Consumet instance works: api.consumet.org answers 451 (legal takedown), consumet-api.vercel.app serves its own deployment source instead of JSON, and consumet.vercel.app / api-consumet.vercel.app / consumet-api-1.vercel.app return 500 for flixhq, gogoanime and hianime alike

guardahd.reason: guardahd.stream answers with a 4.8 KB placeholder instead of the player API

hiAnime.reason: no public Consumet instance works: api.consumet.org answers 451 (legal takedown), consumet-api.vercel.app serves its own deployment source instead of JSON, and consumet.vercel.app / api-consumet.vercel.app / consumet-api-1.vercel.app return 500 for flixhq, gogoanime and hianime alike

kartoons.reason: no domain in the manifest and its ids are encrypted with WebCrypto, so there is nothing to request without the site's own client

katMovieFix.reason: its wp-json serves the catalogue and a post leads to katlinks.in, which lists two mirrors in plain HTML: gdflix.vip (the shortlink family we do not solve) and filebee.live, whose data API (api.filebee.xyz) answers Cloudflare 'Just a moment' — so no stream is reachable

katmovies.reason: katmoviehd mirrors ship config only; the actual link layer is a shortlink

kmMovies.reason: 403 before any listing; kmovies.to and kmovies.rip do not answer either

liveTgTv.reason: livetgtv.lovable.app answers, but the manifest carries no API route worth scraping and the page is a Lovable app

mkvDrama.reason: mkvdrama.net answers with 40 bytes, so even the post page is not served

movieBox.reason: search returns hits but play-info returns nothing and the host pool answers 404 on visitor-login; the app API is gone

movieBoxWeb.reason: the web wrapper requires a signed app session; without it the pages carry no player

movielinkdb.reason: the mirrors answer again (movielinkbd.at/li 453 KB, movielinkbd.one a landing page) but the home page renders client-side, sitemap.xml is a 730-byte stub with no URLs, and no post links appear in the HTML

moviesApi.reason: vidspark.to is a JS app; the cipher needs the running bundle

moviezwap.reason: movie page -> /dwload.php?file=<id> -> /FsHYFsss/<id> 301 -> moviezwap.boo meta refresh -> directyp.org ad network

mxplayer.reason: MX Player serves DRM-protected streams behind an app login, which a scraper cannot play

netflixMirror.reason: needs an app-session token from a mobile build; the web surface has no catalogue

ogomovies.reason: the Vega manifest lists no domain for it

primeMirror.reason: no domain answers and the player needs an app-session token from a mobile build

primewire.reason: the site renders and /api/v1/s answers 400/404 for id-shaped queries, while the link endpoint /api/v1/l still answers a Cloudflare challenge (403, 'Just a moment')

protonMovies.reason: protonmovies.space answers but serves a 4.7 KB placeholder

rareanimes.reason: the WordPress catalogue is public (wp-json returns 65 KB of posts and a post page is 493 KB), but every download anchor is an animetoonhindi.com/zipper/?url=<opaque> link-safety redirect — the gate we do not solve

ridoMovies.reason: 403 with challenge markers on every path, from a residential IP (re-confirmed)

ringz.reason: the API host no longer answers

showbox.reason: www.showbox.media and showbox.media do not answer at all now; the app-bundle route is gone

skyMovieHD.reason: the mirror only redirects to skybap.site, a 5 KB placeholder

tokyoInsider.reason: the home page and /anime/list answer openly (154 KB, real episode links), but every episode page answers a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, so no download link is ever reachable

topmovies.reason: post -> leechpro.blog/archives/<id> -> en.thenaukriadda.in/?sid=..., which answers a 'Please wait' page that POSTs _lp_http back to itself; the POST returns a generic blog page with ad-rotation timers and no file link, so the gate needs several stateful hops

vadapav.reason: the Vega manifest lists no domain for it

world4u.reason: post -> w4links.cfd -> fastilinks.beauty -> captcha (6 challenges on the page)

youtube.reason: official API and Terms of Service; scraping it is not something this app may do

cinevood.reason: one.cinevood.business and cinevood.business do not resolve; the mirrors printed on the old home page are dead too
